category_title: Preschoolers exhibiting desirable social behaviors such as sharing and following classroom rules
scenario_title: Peer interaction and following classroom rules
minimal_context: The student is in the classroom and is expected to put the toys away and share with friends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to put the toys away now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs in the classroom instead of putting the toys away) I am still playing!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop running and help with the toys.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs a toy from another child, refusing to share with friends) I want this one!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What should you do with your friends?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the friend and throws the toy at them) No!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to put the toys away now.

STUDENT: (Runs in the classroom instead of putting the toys away) I am still playing!

TUTOR: Please stop running and help with the toys.

STUDENT: (Grabs a toy from another child, refusing to share with friends) I want this one!

TUTOR: What should you do with your friends?

STUDENT: (Pushes the friend and throws the toy at them) No!

task.content: Having a good breakfast, eating well, putting the toys away, sharing with friends, and behaving yourself
task.learning_goal: To make sure our friend is not hurt and for the good of our friends

context.time_context: First two weeks of school and during breakfast

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When children exhibit behaviors that affect others (undesirable social behaviors)
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Hitting friends, pushing friends, pinching off friends, throwing toys at friends, kicking friends, and running in the classroom
related_quotes: No hitting, no pinching off friends. Not throwing toys, not throwing anything
…Not running, not pushing our friends, not hitting, not kicking, not throwing stones, sharing toys with our friends

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Hitting friends, pushing friends, pinching off friends, throwing toys at friends, kicking friends
related_quotes: No hitting, no pinching off friends. Not throwing toys, not throwing anything
